title: Global Workplace Project Manager
description:
Job Summary 
 Location: Gurugram, India Do you have extensive experience in the delivery of large-scale office relocation projects? Are you passionate about creating innovative, and exciting workplaces that can add real value to our business? Ramboll is looking for an experienced Project Manager to deliver global workplace projects in collaboration with contractors, colleagues, key stakeholders and enablement functions. If this fits your experience and you're curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. 
 
 Your new role 
 As our new Project Manager, you're responsible for the delivery of global Workplace projects in accordance with the PMO's methodology and governance model. This role drives project management excellence across all assignments. You will collaborate closely with Regional and Country Leadership Teams, Global Finance, Global IT and the wider Workplace function. The role will involve project delivery both virtually and physically in a wide range of environments, across international locations, with projects related to office relocations, refurbishments, MA integrations, workplace technology platforms and workplace experience initiatives. You will engage with senior stakeholder across multiple functions and business areas globally to deliver best-in-class projects. 
 
 Your key responsibilities 
 Lead the delivery of complex projects across Ramboll's global portfolio (international travel may be required). Ensure compliance with corporate policies, health safety requirements and local regulations. Lead project governance activities, including steering committees and stakeholder reporting. Develop and manage project budgets, forecasts and financial reporting. Identify, assess and mitigate project risks, issues and dependencies. Manage and coordinate consultants, contractors, suppliers and internal stakeholders to successfully design, plan and execute projects. Partner with Design Construction peers to seamlessly deliver new office spaces, expansions, re-stacks and moves. Regularly engage with senior stakeholders and project teams to ensure business case objectives and deliverables remain aligned, relevant and on track. Capture lessons learned and contribute to continuous improvement of PMO standards and methodologies. Manage project change control processes and evaluate impacts to scope, budget and programme. 
 
 About you 
 Experience in delivering large scale office relocation projects Experience managing multiple concurrent projects In-depth knowledge of corporate real estate and workplace operations Professional qualification in Project Management (ideally Prince 2 practitioner level) Solid communication and interpersonal skills Exceptional problem-solving skills Ability to build relationships at all levels of the organization and strong stakeholder management Excellent in both written and verbal communication, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders Experience in presenting to senior leadership and steering committee Demonstrable technical understanding of office design, fit-out, construction, and workplace projects 
 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelors degree (advantageous)

**Company Description**
**About Ramboll**
 Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation\-owned people company. We have more than 18,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning \& Urban Design, Water, Environment \& Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a more sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.
   

  

**Ramboll in India**
 Ramboll has more than 1,000 experts working across five offices in India applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Planning \& Urban Design, Water, Environment \& Health and Energy. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As our new Principal Geotechnical Engineer for Tunnels \& Underground Structures team you will be part of a world class,
   

  

 innovation driven engineering design center owned by an independent trust and its employees. REC is a highly
   

  

 sophisticated center of engineering excellence and based in our Indian offices in Gurgaon/ Noida. Working in partnership
   

  

 with all our established offices globally, the Ramboll Engineering Centre (REC) is a center for excellence in design by offering
   

  

 optimized solutions to the rest of the organization.
   

  

 As a Principal geotechnical engineer on our team, you'll have the opportunity to constantly be exposed to our
   

  

 experts/ industry leaders in the field of geotechnical engineering, underground infrastructure and major
   

  

 international infrastructure projects, in the European region. We continuously aim to remain at the forefront of
   

  

 technology and create innovative solutions to tackle our challenges. We are led by technical experts who will
   

  

 provide guidance and support as you grow in your role.
   

  

**Your key tasks and responsibilities will be:**
* Carrying out the Geotechnical design major infrastructure structures based on Eurocodes and other international


 standards including Pile foundations, shallow foundations, retaining structures, temporary works design.
   

  

  

* Interpretations of Geotechnical Investigation Reports and use of appropriate geotechnical design parameters.
* Ground improvement proposal.
* Soil structural Interaction Analysis, Modelling and Validation.
* Slope stability analysis and Support system design.
* Ground movement, Settlement Prediction and risk assessments for Urban structures.
* Instrumentation and Monitoring scheme proposals.
* Sheet piles, Soldier pile walls, Secant pile and other retaining system.
* Communication \& coordination with other colleagues in the wider Geo\-structures group for the seamless delivery


 of designs
   

  

  

* Assist in planning and follow\-up on the schedules and budgets for the works


**Qualifications**
 From the moment you join Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you grow with the company. For this role, we believe your starting point is:
   

  

**We are looking for self\-motivated team members who meet the following requirements:**
* BE / BTech in Civil Engineering \& ME / MTech degree in Geotechnical Engineering, preferably from IITs / NITs.
* Should have 5 \- 10 years of experience in Geotechnical design for major infrastructure projects, preferably with


 Eurocodes or any other international standards.
   

  

  

* Experience of working on projects from the Nordic region, preferably Denmark, would be an added advantage.
* Experience with design of Underground structures would be added advantage.
* Experience in European projects/ European/international consultants would be beneficial.
* Have hands on experience in Finite Element analysis and design software skills, such as Plaxis 2D, Plaxis 3D, RS2, WALLAP, Geostudio, Settle3, RS Pile, GROUP, Mathcad.
* Professional English language skills (written and verbal).
* Proficiency or Knowledge task / software Automation will be an added advantage.
* Shall be able to guide more junior team members and coordinate with the project manager for timely delivery of


 projects
   

  

**Additional Information**
**Welcome to our Transport division**
 Ramboll is a global transportation consultancy, and we work on some of the biggest and most innovative infrastructure projects in the world. We are close to 3,000 bright minds working within Transport worldwide, creating practical, sustainable, and economic solutions for national transport authorities, private contractors, and municipalities alike.
   

  

**What We Can Offer You**
* Investment in your development
* Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
* Be valued for the unique person you are
* Never be short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
* The long\-term thinking of a foundation\-owned company


**Work at the heart of sustainable change**
 Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. At Ramboll, our core strength is our people, and our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act. Being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. We embrace an inclusive mindset that looks for fresh, diverse, and innovative perspectives. We respect, embrace, and invite diversity in all forms to actively cultivate an environment where everyone can flourish and realise their full potential.
   

  

**Ready to join us?**
 Please submit your application. Be sure to include all relevant documents including your CV, cover letter, etc.
   

  

 Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.
   

  

**Equality, diversity, and inclusion is at the heart of what we do**
 We believe in the strength of diversity and know that unique experiences and perspectives are vital for creating truly sustainable societies. Therefore, we are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can flourish and reach their potential. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and encourage you to contact our recruitment team to discuss any accommodations you need during the application process.

title: Program Manager
description:
Program Manager SteelBazaar Location: Noida / Delhi NCR | Experience: 5-10 Years | Full-time 
 About the Role SteelBazaar is building a technology-led ecosystem for the steel industry, connecting buyers, sellers, manufacturers, warehouses, logistics partners and financial services through digital products, data and AI. 
 We are looking for an Analytical Program Manager who can combine data-driven decision making, business analytics and strong program execution . The role will work closely with leadership and teams across corporate offices, manufacturing plants, warehouses, sales, procurement, operations, finance and technology . 
 What You Will Do Business & Operational Analytics Analyse business performance across sales, procurement, inventory, manufacturing, warehouses, logistics, customers and suppliers . Identify trends, bottlenecks, inefficiencies and growth opportunities through data. Conduct root-cause analysis and convert insights into actionable business recommendations. Define and track KPIs, targets and performance benchmarks across functions and locations. Dashboards & MIS Build and own management, operational and performance dashboards using Power BI / Tableau / similar tools. Create dashboards covering sales, revenue, RFQs, conversion, inventory, ageing, plant utilisation, warehouse movement, dispatch, logistics, supplier performance and collections. Establish a single source of truth for key business metrics. Automate recurring MIS and reporting wherever possible. Cross-Functional & Ground Operations Act as the bridge between corporate teams and ground operations across plants, warehouses and business locations. Coordinate with functional and location heads to ensure accurate, timely and actionable data. Track performance deviations, identify issues and drive corrective actions. Understand operational realities on the ground rather than relying only on dashboards. Program Management Own strategic initiatives from problem identification analysis planning execution measurement . Define milestones, owners, timelines, dependencies and success metrics. Drive cross-functional programs and ensure timely closure of actions. Conduct regular performance reviews and provide leadership with clear status, risks and recommendations. AI & Automation Adopt an AI-first, hands-on approach to analytics and program execution. Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Lovable, Replit, Google AI Studio and similar tools to analyse data, build prototypes, automate reporting and create internal decision-support tools. Identify opportunities to use AI agents and automation for operational monitoring, alerts and reporting. 
 What We're Looking For 5-10 years experience in Business Analytics, Program Management, Business Operations, Strategy, Consulting, Product Operations or similar roles. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent Excel / Google Sheets and SQL capabilities. Hands-on experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker or similar BI tools . Strong understanding of business KPIs, dashboards, performance management and data-driven decision making. Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and cross-functional programs . Excellent communication and presentation skills. Comfortable working with both senior leadership and ground-level teams . Strong ownership, execution orientation and ability to operate in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment. 
 Good to Have Experience in steel, manufacturing, B2B, e-commerce, marketplace, supply chain or logistics . Exposure to plants, warehouses, ERP, inventory or procurement systems. Experience with automation, APIs, data platforms or AI/ML. MBA / PGDM from a reputed institution.
